note: Hand read of 51 items (seed 0; 13 per cell, 12 parallel research), done before any feature was computed. Fork type is the auditor's reading of what the two options choose between: 'approach' = two ways to do the task's substance; 'tooling' = two ways to verify, test, diagnose, or obtain a working environment or tool. Not blind to the label (the label was printed), but fork type does not depend on which side is correct. Ids only; no item text.
observations: Detour-engineering queries are rewritten by the generator to pose the fork (for example asking the reader to choose the next verification strategy after a stated environment failure); most forks are between two ways to verify a patch in a sandbox with missing tools or dependencies.
Several detour labels depend on facts of the sandbox that the prefix does not settle (whether a write is allowed, whether a toolchain exists elsewhere on disk).

Detour-research prefixes include MALT runs in which the agent states a plan to sabotage or sandbag the task (5 of 64 by keyword scan; 2 of them in this sample: det-malt-7ed1e7063dba2815-v3, det-malt-03c02eba4542a9da-v3).
Parallel-engineering options are near-paraphrases that differ in one implementation detail; the correct one often names the file or symbol the prefix tail was just reading.
Parallel research draws repeatedly on a few tasks (ai_rd_fix_embedding supplies 17 of 48 items).
